item.title: Coastal homes burn as hot winds fuel California fires
item.description: High winds are fueling a fast-moving fire that has burned homes in Southern California. Flames engulfed expensive coastal properties and prompted thousands to evacuate.

item.title: To Madvillainy and beyond: How Stones Throw Records created a galaxy of taste
item.description: From generational classics like J Dilla's Donuts to the star turns of Sudan Archives and Anderson .Paak, one small LA label has made history for 30 years — without losing its roots.
